To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Gamification is an effective tool for motivating engagement with business applications, and we can design gamified business applications to be effective through a process of deconstructing gamified business applications into layers of game mechanics, game elements, and game design.

the design of a business application should include a layer for gamification that is based on the following design guidelines: 1) provide a meaningful goal, 2) make the application fun, 3) make the application easy, 4) make it a social experience, 5) provide immediate feedback, 6) provide a sense of progress, 7) provide autonomy, 8) provide mastery, and 9) provide a sense that the application is a challenge.
gamification is a design layer that can be deconstructed into three main categories: gameplay, motivation and system design.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how gamification can be applied in business applications and the conditions under which gamification is effective.
understanding what makes gamification of business application effective and what design techniques can be applied to achieve that.
the design of gamified business systems and how to design for effective gamification.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the kaleidoscope of gamification is a design-centric model for effective gamification that can help developers of gamified business solutions create effective gameplay strategies and design techniques.
the kaleidoscope of gamification provides a design-centric framework to guide the design of effective gamified business applications.
the kaleidoscope of gamification is an effective model for the design of gamified business systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have created a model for gamification in business that is based on the design of game mechanics.
the gamification layer should not be designed in isolation, but should be designed as part of a larger system.
gamification should be designed with the end-user in mind.
The main takeaway from our work is that
gamification should not be seen as a single design layer, but as the kaleidoscope of design layers that work together to create a gamified business application that is effective.
the gamification layer of business applications should focus on the design of the game experience, the game elements, and the gamification strategy.
effective gamification of applications can be achieved by creating an engaging gameplay experience that is aligned with a user’s intrinsic motivation.
